extraction_notes: Catalysts were prepared as nominal 10 wt% Ni; component loadings reported here use actual Ni loadings from ICP in Table 4 where available. Standard reaction conditions applied from the Catalytic tests section/Fig. 1 caption: fixed-bed reactor, atmospheric pressure, 0.3 g catalyst, WHSV 14,000 cm3/(g cat h), total flow 70 cm3/min, CO2/H2/He = 1/4/5. Table 1 also reports surface-normalized rates r_s and TOF at 200 °C; because the schema has only one rate field, the mass-normalized r_m values at 250 °C were entered in ch4_rate with their printed unit µmol CO2/g.s. Figure 2/3 values are approximate visual readings. The MgO/CaO XCO2 values at 250 °C in the parsed Table 1 conflict with the text and Table 2; values were corrected to Ni/MgO 5.7% and Ni/CaO 6.7%, while retaining their printed r_m rows.
